name: Baby and Me Music & Movement
location: Andre Alfonso Music, 777 S Milwaukee Ave, Suite C, Lake Villa
raw: Andre Alfonso Music / Baby and Me Music & Movement / Ages: 6mo - 4yrs. 9:00-9:30am on select Saturdays / Even the littlest musicians can stomp their feet to the beat in this Baby & Me Music & Movement class! This is free and open to infants and their caretakers. Not a drop off event. You do not need to be a student to join! Go online to “Programs” for a complete list of dates. / Free! Open to all families! / 2026 Dates: September 12th, October 3rd, November 7th, December 5th / www.andrealfonsomusic.com / 777 S Milwaukee Avenue, Suite C, Lake Villa, IL, 60046
notes: Baby & Me music and movement class -- littlest musicians stomp to the beat. Caretaker attends with the child; NOT a drop-off event. You do not need to be an Andre Alfonso Music student to join. Runs 9:00-9:30am on select Saturdays; the four fall 2026 dates come from the studio's own flyer. The flyer points to "Programs" online for the full date list, but as of 2026-09-03 the site publishes no Baby & Me page, so the flyer is the only date source.
